heroTagline: The backbone that holds when the wind blows.
heroLead: A course about responsibility – not about holding the right opinions. Twelve modules from the book series Ta Befäl: over yourself, over others, over the organisation. With stories from the bridge, the engine room and the workplace – and a command assignment for every week.
howText: The arc comes from the lecture in Step 1. No points, no badges. Every choice shows what follows – and who carries it. Every module ends with the same question: What will YOU take command of until next time?
arcNote: Recognition → friction → clarity → responsibility. The recommendation is one module a week.

aboutLead: A web course in twelve episodes by Torbjörn Holkner. The aim is not to create more theories of leadership – but to provoke action.
aboutStructure: Twelve modules in three parts – over yourself, over others, over the organisation and beginning again – about {minutes} hours in total. Every module follows the same arc: recognition, friction, clarity, responsibility. It starts with a lesson, tests you in a scenario built on a story from the books, gives you a tool and ends with a command assignment.
aboutDidactics: The instructor’s handbook in Step 1 is clear. That is why the course is built like this:
did1: No points, badges or leaderboards. Nothing is rewarded for clicking.
did2: No “right!” or “wrong!” – instead the course shows what follows and who carries the consequence.
did3: At most five terms per screen.
did4: Every module ends with a command assignment. Undone assignments are not chased – only: “Then you know where your obstacle is.”
did5: No ideological or political debate. The chapters on citizenship, domestic politics, school, energy and infrastructure in Step 2 are not part of the course.
did6: Quotes always appear in Swedish, with translation and source.
use1: Take the modules in order. The recommendation is one module a week, twelve weeks.
use2: Give the command assignment time in real life before you start the next module.
use3: Everything works with keyboard, mouse and touch. You sort by tapping – not by dragging.
use4: Choose language and light or dark mode at the top right.
use5: Your answers and texts are in My logbook. You can also print or delete them there.
privacyText: The course uses no cookies, no analytics and no third-party services. Fonts and images are served from the same server as the course. Everything you write is stored only locally in your browser and sent nowhere. You can delete everything in My logbook.
statusLead: This is a draft for review by Torbjörn Holkner. What is still missing or needs confirmation:
status1: The video lessons. The lessons currently show the script as text.
status2: The author’s own content for module 9 (WASTA) and module 10 (Meritocracy). For now these modules draw on related chapters and are marked.
status3: Expert review of the German and English texts.
status4: The examination case and the certificate.
status5: The name “5-step rocket” is used in Step 3 for two different models (ch. 7 and ch. 8). The course uses it for setting boundaries in ch. 8.
booksAuthor: All by Torbjörn Holkner, published under OVÄLD®. The course reproduces short quotes with their source.

format3: Lecture series – twelve lectures of 45–50 minutes with conversation.
format4: Compact course after Step 1 – eight sessions of 90 minutes.
